SELECT 
  circuitId,
  COUNT(*) as race_count,
  ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races), 4) as share,
  ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) - CAST(1.0 AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT circuitId) FROM races), 4) as excess
FROM races
GROUP BY circuitId
HAVING CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) > CAST(1.0 AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT circuitId) FROM races)
ORDER BY excess DESC, circuitId ASC
LIMIT 10
